# @zyvnox/vue-pack — Full Technical Documentation & LLM Reference

## Overview
`@zyvnox/vue-pack` is a modern, enterprise-ready, schema-driven Vue 3 component library and developer toolkit. Built with TypeScript and UnoCSS, it is designed for rapid development of administrative dashboards, data-intensive web applications, and schema-driven CRUD interfaces.

- Package Name: `@zyvnox/vue-pack`
- License: MIT
- Repository: https://github.com/zyvnox/vue-pack
- Documentation: https://zyvnox.github.io/vue-pack/
- Peer Dependencies: `vue >= 3.5.0`, `zod >= 4.0.0`, `leaflet >= 1.9.4`

---

## 1. Installation & Plugin Registration

```bash
npm install @zyvnox/vue-pack zod
```

### Global Registration in Vue 3:
```typescript
import { createApp } from 'vue'
import App from './App.vue'
import VuePack from '@zyvnox/vue-pack/vue'
import '@zyvnox/vue-pack/style.css'

const app = createApp(App)
app.use(VuePack, {
  lang: 'en', // 'en' | 'id'
})
app.mount('#app')
```

### Direct Component Import (Tree-Shaking):
```vue
<template>
  <FormModal :schema="schema" :initial-data="formData" @submit="handleSubmit" />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { FormModal, TextInput, TabelData } from '@zyvnox/vue-pack/components'
import type { Schema } from '@zyvnox/vue-pack/type'
</script>
```

---

## 2. Core Engines

### 2.1 FormModal Engine
`FormModal` automates dialog forms using declarative JSON schema contracts with Zod validation, tabs, dynamic field rendering, and on-page SEO calculation.

#### Schema Interface:
```typescript
interface Schema {
  [fieldKey: string]: {
    type: 'text' | 'number' | 'currency' | 'email' | 'password' | 'tel' | 'url' |
          'textArea' | 'quillEditor' | 'select' | 'tag' | 'color' | 'date' |
          'time' | 'dateTime' | 'file' | 'fileArray' | 'image' | 'imageArray' |
          'toggle' | 'rate' | 'location' | 'arrayObject' | 'object' | 'group'
    label: string
    required?: boolean
    placeholder?: string
    tooltip?: string
    tooltipPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'
    options?: string[]
    optionsView?: string[]
    tab?: string
    disabled?: boolean
    validate?: Record<string, any>
  }
}
```

#### Example Usage:
```vue
<template>
  <FormModal
    v-if="showModal"
    :schema="articleSchema"
    :initial-data="currentArticle"
    :is-update="isEditMode"
    :lang="'id'"
    @submit="handleSave"
    @cancel="showModal = false"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { FormModal } from '@zyvnox/vue-pack/components'
import type { Schema } from '@zyvnox/vue-pack/type'

const showModal = ref(true)
const isEditMode = ref(false)
const currentArticle = ref({})

const articleSchema: Schema = {
  title: {
    type: 'text',
    label: 'Judul Artikel',
    required: true,
    placeholder: 'Masukkan judul...',
  },
  category: {
    type: 'select',
    label: 'Kategori',
    options: ['tech', 'design', 'business'],
    optionsView: ['Teknologi', 'Desain', 'Bisnis'],
    required: true,
  },
  body: {
    type: 'quillEditor',
    label: 'Isi Konten',
    required: true,
  },
}

const handleSave = (payload: Record<string, any>) => {
  console.log('Saved payload:', payload)
  showModal.value = false
}
</script>
```

---

### 2.2 TabelData Suite
A high-performance datatable component with sorting, server-side/client-side pagination, search, batch row selection, column projection, and export support.

#### Example Usage:
```vue
<template>
  <TabelData
    :headers="headers"
    :items="items"
    :actions="['create', 'edit', 'delete']"
    @edit="handleEdit"
    @delete="handleDelete"
    @create="handleCreate"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { TabelData } from '@zyvnox/vue-pack/components'

const headers = [
  { key: 'id', label: 'ID', sortable: true },
  { key: 'name', label: 'Full Name', sortable: true },
  { key: 'role', label: 'Role' },
  { key: 'status', label: 'Status' },
]

const items = ref([
  { id: 1, name: 'Alice Smith', role: 'Admin', status: 'Active' },
  { id: 2, name: 'Bob Johnson', role: 'Developer', status: 'Inactive' },
])

const handleEdit = (row: any) => console.log('Edit row:', row)
const handleDelete = (row: any) => console.log('Delete row:', row)
const handleCreate = () => console.log('Create new entry')
</script>
```

---

### 2.3 SEO Engine (`calculateSeo`)
A real-time on-page SEO calculation utility evaluating meta lengths, focus keyword placement, heading hierarchy, image alt attributes, and content density without DOM dependency (SSR-safe).

```typescript
import { calculateSeo } from '@zyvnox/vue-pack'

const result = calculateSeo(
  {
    title: 'Vue 3 Component Library Guide',
    metaTitle: 'Vue 3 Schema Component Library - Enterprise UI Pack',
    metaDescription: 'A high-performance vue 3 component library built with TypeScript.',
    bodyContent: '<h2>Overview</h2><p>Vue 3 component library guide for developers.</p>',
    focusKeyword: 'vue 3 component library',
  },
  {
    seo: {
      contentType: 'article',
      meta: {
        title: 'metaTitle',
        description: 'metaDescription',
        focusKeyword: 'focusKeyword',
      },
      content: {
        title: 'title',
        body: 'bodyContent',
      },
    },
  }
)

console.log(result.score) // 0-100
console.log(result.details) // Array of passed/failed rule checks
```

---

## 3. Subpath Module System

1. `@zyvnox/vue-pack`: Main package entrance.
2. `@zyvnox/vue-pack/components`: Vue 3 SFC component exports.
3. `@zyvnox/vue-pack/config`: Reactive configuration manager and locale controller.
4. `@zyvnox/vue-pack/init`: Application bootstrapping routines.
5. `@zyvnox/vue-pack/indexedDB`: Persistent client-side IndexedDB caching engine.
6. `@zyvnox/vue-pack/secureFetch`: Safe request utility with built-in token lifecycle.
7. `@zyvnox/vue-pack/type`: Complete TypeScript definitions and schema interfaces.
8. `@zyvnox/vue-pack/style.css`: Compiled UnoCSS production styles.
